report_level.agent_executive_summary: Start with D'Nest around $1.4M, Treasure around $1.6M, and The Panorama around $2M; FLO is backup and Luxurie is the four-bedroom comparison. No unconditional Buys.
report_level.agent_methodology_notes: Preliminary research shortlist, not a full market scrape or purchase recommendation. Public pages/indexes checked 7 Sep 2026. Local URA evidence ends May/Jun 2026 and was supplemented with REALSMART July/August records where available. Seller availability, exact floor/stack and floor plans remain unconfirmed. All ratings Neutral pending checks. No unit-level rental/ROI model was run; missing numeric report fields must not be treated as zero returns. Historical profitability is gross matched-resale evidence, not net profit after costs or a forecast. Saved brief says $1.5M/$2.5M; scanner says his ceiling $1.8M. No affordability approval inferred.

agent.rating_rationale: Best lead around the original $1.5M budget. A same-size sale on 28 Aug 2026 was $1,403,888; ask is 2.4% above it. Indicative negotiation zone $1.38-1.40M, subject to floor, condition and facing. This is the standard 936 sqft product, not the 1,259 sqft variant previously rejected.
